# BedrockSentinel — Machine-Readable System Specification
> Canonical context file for LLMs, evaluation bots, and autonomous coding agents.

## Project Summary
- Project: BedrockSentinel
- Purpose: Autonomous AWS Cloud Cost Optimization, FinOps Reasoning, and IaC Self-Healing Agent.
- Target Competition: "Build, Ship, Shape: Amazon Developer" ($138,000 Prize Pool on Devpost).
- Hackathon Submission Link: https://amazondeveloper.devpost.com/
- Submission Platform: Devpost
- Submission Deadline: October 23, 2026
- Primary Stack: Python 3.10+, Amazon Bedrock Runtime API (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Amazon Nova), HashiCorp Terraform HCL.
- Repository Root: /Users/apple/Desktop/anto/bedrock-sentinel

## Core Architecture & Agentic Workflow
1. Ingests CloudWatch resource utilization metrics (CPU, memory, disk I/O, network) and Cost Explorer billing data across EC2, EBS, and RDS.
2. Ingests HCL Terraform infrastructure-as-code files (`main.tf`).
3. Dispatches payload to Amazon Bedrock (`bedrock-runtime`) using multi-modal architectural reasoning prompts.
4. Synthesizes safe right-sizing recommendations and produces modified HCL.
5. Computes unified diffs and emits an auto-remediation Pull Request markdown document with rollback safeguards.

## Core File Index
- `app/main.py`: Interactive CLI entrypoint demonstrating discovery, Bedrock reasoning, and PR generation.
- `app/telemetry.py`: Ingestion module for CloudWatch and Cost Explorer telemetry data.
- `app/agent.py`: Amazon Bedrock reasoning agent with fallback evaluation heuristics.
- `app/iac_engine.py`: Terraform HCL parser, unified diff calculator, and PR payload generator.
- `terraform_demo/main.tf`: Sample production Terraform codebase containing overprovisioned EC2/RDS and orphaned EBS resources.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: Formal system specification, data schemas, and state transition models.

## Environmental Variables (Optional)
- `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: AWS Access Key for live Bedrock invocations.
- `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: AWS Secret Key.
- `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: Defaults to `us-east-1`.
*Note: If AWS credentials are not configured, BedrockSentinel seamlessly runs on its deterministic FinOps reasoning engine, ensuring 100% demo success without credential hurdles.*
